title: MERN Stack Development
subtitle: Development / Mobile Engineer
description: The MERN stack is a JavaScript-based framework for developing web applications. It consists of MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. This course will guide you through building full-stack applications using these technologies.
syllabus: Building REST APIs with Node.js and Express

reviews.name: Amit Sinha
reviews.comment: One of the best MERN stack courses I've taken. The examples are super practical.

reviews.name: Neha Sharma
reviews.comment: Clear and concise. I landed an internship using the skills from this course!

title: Data Science & Machine Learning
subtitle: AI / Data Science
description: This comprehensive course introduces you to the world of Data Science and Machine Learning. Learn how to clean, visualize, and model data using Python and popular libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
syllabus: Data Wrangling with Pandas and NumPy
Data Visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Machine Learning Algorithms and Model Evaluation

reviews.name: Rahul Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Excellent course content and great explanations by the instructor. Totally worth it!

reviews.name: Priya Nambiar
reviews.comment: Super engaging! I feel much more confident in applying for data roles now.
